Remark
[Totally geodesic hypersurfaces and constant curvature]

Source: petersen:page-0123 ↗ def:pet-ch3-second-fundamental-form ↗ def:pet-ch3-constant-curvature ↗ rem:pet-ch3-ex-10

1. ch3:3.4.13A hypersurface is totally geodesic if its second fundamental form vanishes. (1) Show that the space forms $S^n_k$ have the property that any tangent vector is normal to a totally geodesic hypersurface. (2) Show that a Riemannian $n$-manifold, $n>2$, with this property has constant curvature. Hint: show $R(X,Y)Z=0$ for pairwise orthogonal $X,Y,Z$ and use section 3.
